Description: Minimal Tecan-only example: connect, load the plate, read it with a saved .mdfx protocol, eject. Step 3 used to call ReadAbsorbance(Wavelength, PlateType), a command the Tecan server has never implemented, so this example could only ever fail at step 3. The reader takes a protocol file, not a wavelength: measurement parameters live in the .mdfx authored in iControl (see Library/Analysis/).
Author: BicoccaLab

Steps.Description: Connect to the reader (empty string = default USB connection)
Run a saved .mdfx protocol. PlateID is filled in automatically from the run context when an earlier step pipetted a plate; PlateType empty keeps whatever plate the .mdfx was authored for.
